surfaces.part: defibrillator or monitor unit on the deck

answer.evidence: The top deck is a large red band over rows 2-16 and is 14 px wide, wider than the 12 px body below it. It ends in a light front-edge line at row 16 (#ee6c6c), and row 17 is a dark eave shadow. Below that, the front face runs rows 18-29 as three drawers with grey handles at rows 20, 24 and 28, and the wheels at rows 30-31 add 2 more rows. The cream and teal unit at rows 3-9 sits on the deck and is decor. The cart has a clear top surface and a clear front face, so it reads as three-quarter view.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small red cart with a monitor on top. It carries 19 visible tones per 16x16 tile, which matches the well (20) and the cheese stall (17) and is well above the hedge (9). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no flat fills. Only 11% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline leans dark red-brown beside the red body and is not a uniform black sticker line. The body shows several red steps with highlight and shadow sides, plus drawer and panel detail, though the board is too small to count steps exactly. It is a little narrower and simpler than the roofed well and the stall, but I see no flat or sticker-like areas, and a careful artist would accept it next to the references.
